---
title: Fork it
guide-section: Get Started
---

Fork this repo to add or change apps. Then:

1. Point your config repo at your fork. The workflow installs from `<config repo owner>/ha-automations` by default, so a fork under the same account needs nothing. Otherwise set the `PACKAGE_REPO` variable. For manual deploys, set `REPO_URL`.
2. Release from your fork as described in [Releasing](releasing.qmd). Deploys install tags from your fork.

Pull requests back to this repo are welcome.
